entities.name: Towashi
entities.description: Main city of modern day Kamigawa, seat of Imperial power, with skyscrapers and neon signs.

entities.name: Jukai Forest
entities.description: Forest from which Towashi was cleared; home of kami.

entities.name: Boseiju
entities.description: Millennia-old tree that grew above the skyline, later corrupted by Tamiyo.

entities.name: Kami
entities.description: Spirits of the forest who retaliated against deforestation.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: Compleated planeswalker who led the Phyrexian assault at Towashi.

entities.name: Emperor
entities.description: Emperor who brokered an agreement between city and kami.

events.summary: Towashi's expansion into Jukai Forest angers the kami, who retaliate.
events.quote: rose from the forest depths to retaliate

events.summary: The emperor brokers an agreement halting growth into the forest and forbidding cutting Boseiju.
events.quote: He brokered an agreement that the city would halt further growth into the forest.

events.summary: Towashi grows upward and Boseiju is lost in the skyline.
events.quote: Towashi was forced to grow upwards instead

events.summary: Boseiju grows again until it eclipses every structure.
Tamiyo leads the Phyrexian assault and corrupts and bursts Boseiju.
events.quote: The tree itself was corrupted by Tamiyo

relations.quote: Towashi is the main city of modern day Kamigawa
